title: Single-chart smooth approximation of compactly supported locally Lipschitz functions on M (parent steps 3–7 for one chart)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold, and let p ∈ M. Then there is an open set W ∋ p with the following property. Let ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ be locally Lipschitz on M and vanish on M outside some compact C ⊆ M ∩ W. Then there are a compact C' ⊆ M and C^∞ compactly supported ζ_k : ℝ^P → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) such that ζ_k = 0 on M ∖ C', ζ_k → ζ uniformly on M, and ∫⁻_M ofReal(Σ_j (Dζ_k(x)(P_xe_j) − d^M_xζ(P_xe_j))²) dH^m(x) → 0. Here Dζ_k = fderiv ℝ ζ_k, d^M_xζ = fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x, P_x is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M x), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, and H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → ∀ p ∈ M, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ p ∈ W ∧ ∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∩ W ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ (C' : Set (Euclid P)) (ζs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact C' ∧ C' ⊆ M ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ζs k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζs k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C' → ζs k x = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn ζs ζ atTop M ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ (ζs k) x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) ∂μHE[m]) atTop (𝓝 0)
